items.title: AYE SHAAH-E KARBALA TERI QIDMATH NA HO SAKI
items.body:
aye sogwaaro aah-o buka ka muqaam hai
ab ruqsat-e hussain alaihis salaam hai
mehmaa'n tumhaara jaata hai jo tashna kaam hai
sar peeto qaak udaao ke maatam tamaam hai
<<MINI>>
ab wo sadaa-e haye hussaina na aayegi
ghar me tumhaare fatima zehra na aayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
aye shaah-e karbala teri qidmat na ho saki
aye kushta-e jafaa teri qidmat na ho saki
aye jaane fatima teri qidmat na ho saki
mehmaan-e- nainawa teri qidmat na ho saki
<<MINI>>
jee bhar ke ro sake na ye gardish naseeb ki
majlis ye aaqri hai hussain-e ghareeb ki
<<DIVIDER>>
agle baras hussain muharram me aayenge
baaqi rahi hayaat to ye gham manaayenge aur fatima ke laal par aansu bahaayenge
gar margaye to qabr me ham qaak udaayenge
tayyaar qaafela hai shah-e mashraqain ka
lo karbala ko jaata hai kunba hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas-e baawafa ali akbar na jaaiye
jhule ko qaali chord ke asghar na jaaiye
lekar baraat qaasim-e bepar na jaaiye
veera'n makaan hota hai sarwar na jaaiye
aayi sadaa na ro azaadar aayenge phir agle saal apne bhare ghar ko laayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
bin byaahe noujawaa'n ali akbar bhi aayenge
mashk o alam ke saath baradar bhi aayenge
baano ki godh me ali asghar bhi aayenge
noushaah banke qaasim-e bepar bhi aayenge
<<MINI>>
zainab ka haath thaame sakina bhi aayegi
ek shab ki byaahi fatima kubra bhi aayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke laal baandhke hathyaar aayenge
sughra mareez aabid-e beemaar aayenge
shabbar ke saath hyder-e karrar aayenge
zehra ko thaame ahmed-e muqtaar aayenge
<<MINI>>
dil kyu na beqaraar ho bint-e rasool ka
majrooh aaj tak bhi hai pehlu batool ka
<<DIVIDER>>
be chain fatima hai na aansu bahaao tum
mai jaa raha hu roke na mujh ko rulaao tum
zehmat na ho to meri ziyaarat ko aao tum
turbat pe aake ashko'n ki chaadar chadhaao tum
<<MINI>>
mehmaa'n jo karbala me mere paas aayenge
un sab ki peshwaai ko abbas aayenge
<<DIVIDER>>
lo alvidaa hota hai ruqsat ye tashna kaam
tum rorahe ho maah-e moharram se subh-o shaam
kousar pe apne haath se dunga mai bhar ke jaam
ruqsat hussain hota hai tum par mera salaam
<<MINI>>
dono jahaa'n me qush raho aur shaad tum raho
amma duaa'e deti hai aabaad tum raho
<<DIVIDER>>
haa aashiqo hussain ke aah-o bukaa karo
zehra ka saath do madad-e mustafa karo
haqq-e mohabbat-e shah-e bekas adaa karo
ab kooch hai hussain ka mehshar bapaa karo
<<MINI>>
lo ab vidaa kijiyo aal-e rasool ko
do aaqri hussain ka pursa batool ko
<<DIVIDER>>
aye tashna kaam-o bekas-o nakaam alwedaa
aye mubtelaa-e hasrat-o aalaam alwedaa
aye bekafan ali ke gul andaam alwedaa
mazbooh tegh-e shimr bad anjaam alwedaa
<<MINI>>
muzlumiyat pe aapki jaa'n apni khoyenge
jab tak hai zinda aapke maatam me royenge
<<DIVIDER>>
aye shah-e karbalaa-e mo'alla salaam lo
ham bekaso'n ke waali-o moula salaam lo
aqaa salaam lo shah-e waala salaam lo
aye fatima ke chaand hamaara salaam lo
<<MINI>>
ruqsat ye aaqri hai dilafgaar aaye hai
moula salaam lo ye azaadaar aaye hai

items.title: WARID HUWI NAAGAAH SHAB-E ZARBATH-E HYDER
items.body:
warid huwi naagaah shab-e zarbat-e hyder
bas kholte hi roza kamar baandhi ajal par
us shab the kabhi sahen me geh hujre ke andar
ham saaya ko har baar nidaa dete the rokar
<<MINI>>
hyder ki sawari sooe firdous chali hai
jaago ye shab-e qadr, shab-e qatl-e ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wallah mai do raato ka mehmaa'n hu’n tumhaara
tar dekhoge kal qoon se resh-e rukh-e zebaa’n
barsega lahoo teen din aflaak se har jaa
aye sahebo is saal ali hajj me na hogaa
<<MINI>>
tum eid ke din ro-oge shabbar se lipat kar
royega hassan baap ke mimbar se lipat kar
<<DIVIDER>>
kulsum ne rokar kaha wa hasrato darda
kya betiya ab sabr kare aap ko baba
kis tarha yaqee'n tum ko huwa apni ajal ka
farmaya jo irshaad-e payambar hai wo hoga
<<MINI>>
do roz hai dunya me bas ab kooch hamaara
ek-kisvi(21) ko uthega taaboot hamaara
<<DIVIDER>>
har ghar me sada hoyegi kal haye ali ki
kal roti huwi aayegi yaa rooh nabi ki
haalat mere gham me na bajaa hogi kisi ki
kal aayegi yaa'n laash payambar ke wasi ki
<<MINI>>
kal shia bhi sar kholenge aur ahle haram bhi
zehra ki sada aayi kafan phaadenge ham bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se rivayat hai ke thi chaar-ghadi raat
mushtaaq-e-qazaa ghar se chale syed-e qush zaat
tasbeeh bakaff jamma huwe deodi pa saadaath
waa'n sheh ne azaa'n di, yaha ki sab ne munajaat
<<MINI>>
guldasta ho hyder se sar afraaz hamesha
ya rab rahe dunya me ye aawaz hamesha
<<DIVIDER>>
phir baad-e azaa'n kaan me aawaaz ye aayi
aye shiyo ali qatl huwe haq ki duhaayi
is nouhe se aagah huvi saari qudaayi
chehrou pa nabi zaadiyou ne qaak udaayi
<<MINI>>
jannat se nabi phaad ke daamaan-e kafan aaye
sar peet-te masjid me hussain aur hassan aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka lahu pehle to chehro'n pa lagaya phir dono ne ma baine gileem unko uthaya
lekar jo chale rona ali ko bahot aaya
shabbir ne poocha to ye hyder ne sunaya
ronaa ye hai jab halq tu katwaayega pyaare
koi tera laasha na utha-laayega pyaare

items.title: SUNAA THA JAB SE KE AATHE HAIN SYED-E- AKRAM
items.body:
watan me qaafela-e- karbala ki aamad hai
sawaariye haram-e- mustafa ki aamad hai
yateem sarwar-e- gulgu'n qabaa ki aamad hai
ghareeb-o- bekas-o- aasna ki aamad hai
<<MINI>>
tamaam shehr hai shayeq ali ke pyaarou ka
nabi ke rouze pa majma hai dost daaro'n ka
<<DIVIDER>>
sunaa tha jab se ke aate hai syed-e- akram
qushi se fatima sughra ka tha ajab aalam
kabhi to jhukti thi sajde me wo badeeda-e- nam
kabhi ye kehti thi kyu naani jaan ji gaye ham
<<MINI>>
watan me aaj shah-e- mashraqain aate hai
chalo chalo mere baba hussain aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
uthi ye sunte hi ummul banee'n ba shouqe tamaam
gayi jo muttasil-e- rouza-e- rasool-e- anaam
suna ye shor ke lo aaye shaah-e- arsh maqaam
nazar wo aata hai dekho nishaaan -e- fouj-e- imaam
<<MINI>>
bade shikwe se hyder ka yaadgaar aaya
alam liye huwe abbas-e- naamdaar aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ye nouha padhta tha ghode ke aage aage basheer
madina lut gaya jangal me margaye shabbir
gale pa dilbar-e- zehra ke chal gayi shamsheer
kiya shaheed ghareebul watan ko be taqseer
<<MINI>>
pada raha jo zamee'n par ye uska jaama hai
kafan mila na jise uska ye amaama hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bitha ke naaqe ko sajjad-e- naatawaa'n utre
asaa ko thaam ke baa chasm qoo fishaa'n utre
qareeb-e- marqad-e- sultaane ins-o- jaa'n utre aur ahle bait ye karte huwe fughaa'n utre
huwi ghareebo'n pe bedaad ya rasool allah
hussain margaye faryaad ya rasool allah
<<DIVIDER>>
huwa jo rouze me daaqil wo qaafela naagaah
gire mazaar-e mubaarak pe abid-e- zeejaah
uthaa ke haath ye faryaad ki ba naala-o- aah
tabaahi aagayi ham bekaso'n pe yaa jaddaah
<<MINI>>
yateem hoke ye naashaad kaam aaya hai
pidar ko khoke watan me ghulaam aaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bada sitam kiya ummat ne ya rasool -e- zaman
kiya huzoor ke pyaaro'n ko zibha tishna dahan
raha sinaa pe sar-e- paak aur zamee'n pe badan
lute ham aise ke baba ko de sake na kafan
<<MINI>>
na din ko thi hame raahat na chain raato ko
jakad diya tha rasan se hamaare haatho'n ko
<<DIVIDER>>
gayi lahad pa phir is tarha zainab-e- meh'zu ke ek haath me sheh ka amaama-e- pur qu aur ek haath me hazrat ka jaama-e- gul gu
zabaa'n pe marsia jis ka ye jaa'n gaza mazmu'n
yazeed ne hame loota duhaayi hai nana
behan shaheed ke mujre ko aayi hai nana
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain bhaai ko ham karbala me chod aaye
ali ke laal ko dasht-e- bala me chod aaye
yateem-e fatima ko nainawa me chod aaye
tumhaare chand ko qaak-e- shifa me chod aaye
<<MINI>>
ye baad qatl ajab tafreqaa pada nana
gada badan kahi'n aur sar kahi'n gada nana
<<DIVIDER>>
huwi hussain ke marne se dar badar zainab
gayi yazeed ki majlis me nange sar zainab
kayi mahine rahi qaid nouhagar zainab
ye saqt jaa'n thi ke jeeti phiri idhar zainab
<<MINI>>
waram hai shaano'n pe dukhthe hai ustoqaa'n nana
ye mere baazu pa rassi ke hai nashaa'n nana

items.title: Aye rozey daaro aaho bukaa ke yeh roz hain
items.body:
Aye rozey daaro aaho bukaa ke yeh roz hain
Saadaath par nuzool-e-balaa ke yeh roz hain
Sartaaj-e-ausiyaa ki azaa ke yeh roz hain
Tumsey vidaa-e-shair-e-khuda ke yeh roz hain
<<MINI>>
Zakhmi huva Imam tumhaara namaaz may
Zaalim ney rozeydaar ko maara namaaz may
<<DIVIDER>>
Maahey mubaarak-e-Ramazaan aur khuda ka ghar
Thaddkaa woh noor ka woh shab-e-Qadr ki sahar
Paish-e-khuda woh sajdeh may shair-e-khuda ka sar
Aur haaye teigh zulm ki zarbath woh farq par
<<MINI>>
Fawaarey khoon ke zakhme jabeen sey bahaa kiye
Sajdeh may aap rabbi-ul-aala kahaa kiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar peeto mominou sar-e-hyder huva doh neem
Imaan ke burj kaama-e-anwar huva doh neem
Souncho toh farq shah ka kyonkar huva doh neem
Likha hai maqz takh sar-e-athar huva doh neem
<<MINI>>
Zehra ney baal kholay nabi nangay sar huvey
Tum bey Imaam aur Hassan bey pidar huvey
<<DIVIDER>>
Likhaa hai jab doh neem huvaa farq-e-Murtuza
Sidhray sey jibraeel ke ronay ka ghul utthaa
Phainkhee saroun sey Zainab-o-Kulsoom ney ridaa
Chillaa ke bhaaiyoun ko pukaari ghazab huva
<<MINI>>
Sunthay ho jibraeel ney is waqt kya kahaa
woh bolay peet kar quthalal Murtuza kahaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Daudey yeh kehkay jaanib-e-Masjid-o-Nekh zaath
Doobi huvi lahoo may mili kashti-e-Najaath
Maathay pa khoon baap ka malkar kahi yeh baath
Hai hai utthaaya Qibla-o-Kaaba pa kisney haath
<<MINI>>
Rulvaaya naana jaan ko Darus-salaam may
Bin baap ka kiya hamein maahey siyaam may
<<DIVIDER>>
Naagaah namaaziyoun ka groh aaya nangay sar
Hyder ney Mujtaba sey kaha aankhein khol kar
Padvaao turn namaaz jamaath ki aye pisar
Hum bhaittay bhaittay paddthay hain apney muqaam par
<<MINI>>
Leikeen jabeen ke zakhm pa rumaal baandho
Mera sar-e-shigaaftaa aye laal baandho
<<DIVIDER>>
Baandha Hassan ney Zakhm-e-sarey shaah-e-Zuljalaal
Bolay Ali ke aur kaso dard hai kamaal
Shabbar ney jab kasaa toh kiya phir wohi miqaal
Phir chusth baandhkar pukaara woh khush qisaal
<<MINI>>
Ab dard kaisa aye Asad-e-Zuljalaal hai
Haathoun sey sar pakadd ke kaha wohi haal hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Padvaa ke phir namaaz jamaath ki Mujtaba
Baba ke sar pa paddney lagay Aaya-e-shifa
Naagaah aakey yeh kisi aurath ney di nidaa
Zehra ke pyaaro turnsey yeh Zainab ney hai kaha
<<MINI>>
Baba ko meray jald jo ghar may na laaogay
Toh sar barehna mujhko bhi Masjid may paaogay
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolay Ali havaas abhi sey bajaa nahin
Zainab sey kehdo kufaa hai yeh karbalaa nahin
Main bey dayaar-o-beikas-o-bey aashnaa nahin
Shia hain girdh nargha-e-ahley jafaa nahin
<<MINI>>
Pardeh sey nangay sar tu abhi kyon nikalthi hai
Kya halq par Hussain ke talwaar chalthi hai

items.title: IMAAN KI JAAN KYA HAI MOHABBAT ALI KI HAI
items.body:
imaa'n ki jaan kya hai mohabbat ali ki hai
raahat jo qabr ki hai wo ulfat ali ki hai
saail bakaf hai sab wo saqaawat ali ki hai
qaatil ko di amaa'n wo murawwat ali ki hai
<<MINI>>
aadil ho, peshwa ho, madaarul mahaam ho
gar ho nabi ke baad to aisa imam ho
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqe ghulam teri musibat ke ya ali
aye jaanashi'n janabe risalat ke ya ali
qurbaa'n lahu bhari teri surat ke ya ali
ayyam hai ye teri shahadat ke ya ali
<<MINI>>
ye zulm be jehat ye sitam be sabab huwa
talwar tere sar pa lagi kya ghazab huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
unniswi'n(19) se aapka maatam hai ya ali
qoo'n hogaye dilo'n ka ye aalam hai ya ali
daftar jaha'n ka darham-o-barham hai ya ali
maahe siyam maahe muharram hai ya ali
<<MINI>>
moula ki nazr ko gohar-e ashk laaye hai
ye rozedaar aapke purse ko aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
moula shigaafta huwa sajde me sar tera
syed tabah hogaya kufe me ghar tera
sarwar alam dilo'n ko hai shaam-o- sahar tera
aaqa inhi dino'n me huwa tha safar tera
<<MINI>>
aalam se be qabar the quzu-o qushu me
talwar jab lagi thi jhuke the ruku me
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar me quda ke qatl hua rozedaar haaye
hai hai imaam haaye shahe zulfeqaar haaye
aye qaana zaad haq shahe taa'at guzaar haaye
moulud haram me hai to najaf me mazaar haaye
<<MINI>>
ye bandagi nisaare janaabe ameer ke
nikle to ghar se mar ke quda e qadeer ke
<<DIVIDER>>
laaya tha zehar me wo jafa joo bujha ke tegh
moula gire zameen pa sajde me khake tegh
ghul padhgaya ke sar pa lagi murtaza ke tegh
khaayi quda ke sher ne ghar me quda ke tegh
<<MINI>>
gehra hai zaqm farqe imame hijaaz par
sar se tapak raha hai lahu jaa-namaz par
<<DIVIDER>>
shera khuda jo haato'n se thaame the apna sar
qoo'n dono kohniyo'n se tapakta tha qaak par
bhaaga jo ibn-e muljim-e maloon-o bad siyar
pakda use ali ke muhibbo'n ne doud kar
<<MINI>>
laaye jo haath baandh ke moula ke saamne
qaatil pa muskura ke nazar ki imaam ne
<<DIVIDER>>
farmaya mai ne kounsi ki thi teri qataa
paadaash nekiyo'n ki yahi hai jaha'n me kya
kya mai bura imaam tha aye baniye jafaa
roya jo sar jhuka ke to moula ne ye kaha
<<MINI>>
is dard me bhi sab ke maraz ki dawa hai ham
baandho na iske haath ke mushkil kusha hai ham
<<DIVIDER>>
dono shabe'n ali ko tadapte huwi basar
lete the is taraf kabhi karwat kabhi udhar
rokar dabaate pau'n jo shabbir-e- naamwar
reh jaate the imaam-e- do alam hilake sar
<<MINI>>
rudaad thi nazar me mujassam hussain ki
awaaz sun ke rote the zainab ke bain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bees-wi ka din bhi tadapkar huwa tamaam
ummul banee'n se chounk ke kehne lage imaam
do din se aah sab mere bache hai be ta-aam
faaqe me in-pe guzregi kya aaj ki bhi shaam
<<MINI>>
accha hu ab to mai ye abas be qaraar hai
khana inhe khilao ke sab rozedaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bole hussain baap se haato'n ko jod kar
sab khaae'n phir jo aap tanaawul kare'n agar
farmaya rizq uth gaya majboor hai pidar
paani bhi ab gale se utarta nahi pisar
<<MINI>>
daawat ali ki aaj hai ghar me ilaah ke
roza khulega saath risalat panah ke
<<DIVIDER>>
chup hogaye ye kehke shahinshah-e kaayenat
samjhe ye sab ke ghash me hai shah-e- nik-o sifaat
jis waqt baaqi rehgayi kuch kam ghadi wo raat
teghe ajal ne qata kiya rishta-e- hayaat
<<MINI>>
tadka tha noor ka ke safar kar gaye ali
sab shia be imaam huwe mar gaye ali

items.title: JIS DAM HASSAN KA ZAHER SE TUKDE JIGAR HUWA
items.body:
jis dam hassan ka zaher se tukde jigar huwa
saipaara dil ka aaho'n se ze-ro- zabar huwa
sam ka jo roo-e- paak pa zaahir asar huwa
haal us imam-e- paak ka is dam digar huwa
<<MINI>>
raahat me farq aur shikam me qalal pada
kat kar kaleja tasht ke andar nikal pada
<<DIVIDER>>
bistar pa dard-e- dil se tadapne lage imam
sadme se sabz hone laga rooe surq faam
chillaye haath se ye kaleje ko thaam thaam
doudo bahan ke kaam hamara huwa tamam
<<MINI>>
ye kehte kehte zard ruq-e- paak hogaya
chillate the ke haye jigar chaak hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
doudhi'n janab-e- zainab-e bekas barahna pa
dekha ke lot-te hai bichone pa mujtaba
boli ye sar ko peet ke wo gham ki mubtela
hai hai bahan nisar ho bhai ye kya huwa
<<MINI>>
kya phir kisi ne zeher dagha se piladiya
kis ne mere kaleje pe khanjar chala diya
<<DIVIDER>>
takya laga rahe the haram jo idhar udhar
baazu ko thaam leti ,thi koi to koi sar
farmaya laao tasht, huwa zeher ka asar
reh reh ke koi kaat'ta hai tegh se jigar
<<MINI>>
badhta tha jab ke dard jigar me imaam ke
jhukte the baar baar kaleje ko thaam ke
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne jald laake rakha samne lagan
hathou'n se dil pakad ke jhuke sarwar-e- zaman
aayi jo qai to kaane jawaahar bana dahan
almaas khake laal ugalne lage hassan
<<MINI>>
range zamroodi ka asar ab ayaa'n huwa
meraaj ki hadees ka matlab ayaa'n huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
farmate the hassan ke bulaao hussain ko
tha dambadam ye hukm, ke laao hussain ko
bhaai ka haale zaar sunaao hussain ko
tukde mere jigar ke dikhao hussain ko
<<MINI>>
kehdo ke jald aaiye rehlat ka waqt hai
sun jaiye kuch aake wasiyat ka waqt hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hussain itne me baa chashm ashkbaar
chillate the ke aapki ghurbath ke mai nisaar
shabbar gale ko choom ke kehte the baar baar
mai tum pa sadqe aye mere nana ke yaadgaar
<<MINI>>
mujh se ziyada zulm-o- sitam tum pa hoyenge
ham qabr me tumhari musibath pa royenge
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiyya tumhari god me niklega mera dam
tum doge hamko ghusl-o- kafan jab marenge ham
hoga tumhare paas na koi bajuz alam
qatil sarhane hoyega ya khanjar-e- sitam
<<MINI>>
shabbar to baad-e marg bhi raahat se soyega
laasha tumhara ghodou'n se pamaal hoyega
<<DIVIDER>>
bole katora leke hussain-e falak janaab
dekhu to peeke mai bhi ke kis tarha ka hai aab
bhai se lipti doud ke zainab jigar kabaab
pakda hassan ne daste baradar basad shitaab
<<MINI>>
jaldi se pee na le ye qalaq tha imam par
ek haath tha kaleje pa ek haath jaam par
<<DIVIDER>>
darde jigar se ghash huwe shaah-e- falak janaab
ghamgee'n to the hussain huwa aur izteraab
haazir thi rooh-e ahmed-o- zehra o- buturaab
wa aasmaa'n pe hogaye baagh-e- jinaa'n ke baab
<<MINI>>
sar peeto momino ke khazaa kar gaye hassan
bin bhai ke hussain huwe margaye hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
barpa tha ahle bait-e-payambar me shor-o shain
behne pachade'n qhaak pa khaati thi karke bain
chaati pe haath maarke chillate the hussain
ab uth gaya zamane se ham bekasou'n ka chain
<<MINI>>
dil ab hamara toot gaya wa musibata
baap aaj hamse choot gaya wa musibata
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ek ko rokte the imam-e- falak sareer
aane lage janaze pa jo us taraf se teer
kaanpi zameen hilgaya sadme se charqe peer
nikli lahad se fatima jebe- kafan ko cheer
<<MINI>>
taboot par nawase ke bid'at jo hoti thi
roohe rasoole paak janaze pa roti thi

items.title: JAB SHAAH KO SAFAR ME BAHOTH DIN GUZAAR GAYE
items.body:
jab shaah ko safar me bohat din guzar gaye
sughra ko gham huwa ke musaafir kidhar gaye
kehti thi ghar bhara huwa veeraan kar gaye
kya jaane kis taraf mere bekas pidar gaye
<<MINI>>
hai shouq dil me sibt-e- payambar ki deed ka
kya wajha hai ke qat nahi aaya raseed ka
<<DIVIDER>>
pardesiyo'n ke gham me hai jeene se mujh ko yaas
bistar pe mu lapete padi rahti hu udaas
baba safar se aayenge jab tak na mere paas
tab tak badan se mai na utarungi ye libaas
